systems.system: Birth certificate issuance at district offices of the Benadir Regional Administration
systems.tiers: Mogadishu district offices take the applicant's details, photo and thumbprint and issue the certificate about a week later, on UNHCR's informal account of February 2023; the response does not say whether a computer system or a connection is used

'some' of 22 municipal governments keep registers and issue birth, death and marriage certificates (a 2016 report as cited); municipal offices of Baidoa, Jubaland and Puntland issue birth certificates (NRC, 2022)

note: A country-of-origin response on birth and marriage certificates; it describes municipal and district offices issuing certificates but states nothing about the offices' connection, and the registration itself is an application.
